column7: Having recently taken the DO180 exam, I can confidently say it is a comprehensive and highly practical test of container orchestration skills. Because the exam is 100% hands-on and performance-based, it truly tests your ability to work under pressure in a real-world environment rather than just memorizing theory. Navigating between the command line and the OpenShift Web Console required a solid, fluid understanding of how to deploy applications, manage resources, and configure storage. The automated grading is incredibly precise, so a huge takeaway for me was the absolute necessity of practicing the lab exercises until the syntax and workflows become second nature. It's a challenging but deeply rewarding exam that provides a solid, enterprise-ready foundation for anyone looking to master Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift.
